title: service-messaging: three follow-ups from the contract review of the role: audience fix (#33320)
body:
security#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcT1w3zpekijraHJE4f

Follow-ups owed by the contract review of PR #33320 (review#2 records 6881335909 and 6882029716). They are non-blocking, and all three are in `@objectstack/service-messaging`.

1. **Preference scoping follows the same organization as the audience.** `MessagingService.emit` step 3b reads recipient preferences with the producer-named organization, while step 3 now resolves `role:` with the emitting organization (the producer's, else the event row's). Decide whether step 3b uses the same organization. Today it only filters, and it is unchanged from main.
2. **A real-engine pin of the event-row fallback.** The fallback is pinned against the file's engine double only. Add one beside `notification-organization-follows-event` on the real engine's derived organization.
3. **`resolveAudience`'s per-spec branch passes a one-entry list** (`[spec]`), so each spec takes the resolver's own list path.
